skill.name: expo-deployment
skill.description: Guides Expo production deployment, app store submission, OTA updates, and release management.
skill.summary: Prepare and ship Expo apps with production build and release guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code. Both static network findings are GitHub source links in documentation, not runtime network behavior or data transfer.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is a source metadata reference to the Expo skill repository. It does not instruct the agent to make network requests or send user data.
The URL is a documentation resource link to the source repository. It is not executable behavior and does not create a network exfiltration path.

content.value_statement: Expo releases require coordinated build, store, and update steps. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan production deployment workflows.
actual_capabilities: Outlines production build preparation for Expo applications.
Guides App Store Connect and Google Play submission planning.
Explains over-the-air update channels and rollout management.
Covers version updates, metadata review, and release coordination.
Suggests production checks for tests, bundle size, and monitoring.
limitations: Does not run EAS Build or submit apps directly.
Does not replace Apple or Google policy review.
Requires project-specific credentials and store access from the user.
Does not verify live production telemetry by itself.

use_cases.title: Plan a First Store Release
use_cases.description: Create a checklist for build settings, app metadata, screenshots, and submission steps.

use_cases.title: Coordinate OTA Rollouts
use_cases.description: Define production and staging update channels with rollout and rollback steps.

use_cases.title: Review Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Check tests, version numbers, bundle size, monitoring, and store assets before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Release Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare an Expo app for production. List the required build, testing, metadata, and submission steps.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Store Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Expo release plan for iOS and Android. Identify missing App Store Connect and Google Play tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Design OTA Update Channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define staging and production OTA update channels for my Expo app, including rollout and rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Release Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this Expo deployment workflow for production risk. Focus on versioning, environment variables, testing, monitoring, and rollback planning.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced team reviewing a launch process

output_examples.input: I need to submit my Expo app to both stores.
output_examples.output: A structured release checklist covering production builds, store metadata, screenshots, review preparation, and post-submit monitoring.

output_examples.input: We need safer OTA updates for production users.
output_examples.output: A rollout plan with staging validation, production channel promotion, adoption monitoring, and rollback steps.

output_examples.input: Review our launch plan before release day.
output_examples.output: A readiness review that flags missing tests, version updates, analytics, error tracking, and release ownership.

best_practices: Test production builds before store submission.
Use separate channels for staging and production updates.
Keep version numbers, metadata, and monitoring plans current.
anti_patterns: Publishing OTA updates without a rollback plan.
Submitting store builds before testing production configuration.
Changing release channels without documenting ownership.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy my app automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and checklists for Expo deployment workflows.

faq.question: Can it help with both iOS and Android?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers App Store Connect, Google Play, and production build preparation.

faq.question: Does it support OTA update planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes update channels, staged rollout planning, monitoring, and rollback guidance.

faq.question: Do I need EAS Build?
faq.answer: The skill recommends EAS Build for reliable production builds, but your project choices still apply.

faq.question: Will it review app store policy compliance?
faq.answer: It can help organize review tasks, but it does not replace Apple or Google policy guidance.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
